unit: Google search (one results page of up to 10 organic results) per month

vendors.name: SerpApi
vendors.note: Monthly plans. Only successful searches count; cached, errored and failed searches do not, and a response counts as one search however many results it returns.

vendors.name: DataForSEO (Standard queue)
vendors.note: Pay per SERP of up to 10 organic results; each additional 10 results is billed as another SERP. Queued tasks, not real-time.

vendors.name: DataForSEO (Priority queue)
vendors.note: Pay per SERP of up to 10 organic results; each additional 10 results is billed as another SERP.

vendors.name: DataForSEO (Live mode)
vendors.note: Real-time results. Pay per SERP of up to 10 organic results; each additional 10 results is billed as another SERP.

vendors.name: Serper
vendors.note: Sells one-time credit packs that stay valid for six months, not monthly plans, so a monthly bar would misstate it. The calculator on this page converts its packs to an effective monthly cost.
